subject: Green Jobs and Workforce Development Planning
overview: The Council reviewed upcoming community events and received updates on city energy programs and composting enrollment. The meeting's primary focus was a detailed discussion on procurement equity, green job training pipelines, and workforce participation goals for city projects.

items.title: Guest Introductions
items.summary: Guests Trey Winter and Margaret Kurth introduced themselves and their backgrounds in science and policy.

items.title: Administrative Business
items.summary: The Council scheduled future meetings for November 18 and December 16 and approved the minutes from the September meeting.

items.title: Winter Preparedness Event
items.summary: The Council finalized details for a November 14 event at the Medford Chamber providing fuel assistance resources and winter gear donations.

items.title: Upcoming Community Events
items.summary: Members discussed participation in the November 2 Pumpkin Smash and the December 4 Winter Extravaganza at City Hall.

items.title: Recent Event Recaps
items.summary: The body reviewed the success of the Bilingual Storytime event and the Harvest Your Energy Festival's electric vehicle showcase.

items.title: City Energy and Sustainability Updates
items.summary: Updates were provided on the 86 residents enrolled in Electrify Medford, the electricity aggregation renewal lowering rates in December, and composting participation levels.

items.title: Green Workforce Development
items.summary: Brenda Pike detailed city procurement rules and minority-owned business goals while the Council discussed connecting residents to building trade training pipelines.

items.title: Future Agenda Items
items.summary: The Council identified future topics including MBTA route changes, tree ordinances, and expanded outreach to religious and non-English speaking communities.
